coverage_summary: The full-fine-tuning confirmation/denial input route is largely supported, including modality encoders, pooling boundaries, conditional protein segmentation, projection, and prefix concatenation. Coverage is incomplete because documented Genolator variants and the generic QA task are absent.

findings.detail: Only the full-fine-tuning trajectory is present, although the paper documents a separate projector-only Genolator variant with a different trainability state.

evidence.quote: Additionally, we evaluated an ablated version of Genolator (TP), in which only the virtual token projectors were trained while the Llama 33 backbone remained frozen.
the Llama 33 backbone was kept fixed and only the token projectors were trained.

findings.required_change: Add a separate projector-only evaluation trajectory, preserving the same documented input path while setting the token projectors trainable and the Llama backbone frozen.

findings.detail: The trajectory covers only confirmation/denial evaluation, while the paper also evaluates open-ended generic QA using the fine-tuned multimodal Llama variants.

evidence.quote: B) Reasoning Assessment on Generic QA (Open-Ended Questions): To evaluate the capacity for generative reasoning, only the fine-tuned multimodal Llama variants (with and without Llama adaptation) were considered.
Here, models were prompted with openended questions regarding the possible biological functions, processes, or components associated with specific sequences.

findings.required_change: Add the documented generic-QA evaluation trajectory for the full and projector-only multimodal Llama variants, or explicitly mark those task routes as outside this record's intended coverage.
